title: The Lifebringer
description: Elder Moor, Millbrook and Thornfield are eating again. Now the wasteland by Willow Dale - the ground that has answered slowest of all. Make that soil grow and nowhere in the valley is past saving.

objectives.description: Gather Sacred Soil from Gaela's shrine in Dalhurst
Gather Moonwater from Elder Moor's sacred spring
Gather a Lifeseed from the Ancient Grove near Crossroads
Clear the corrupted zone near Willow Dale
Perform the Lifebringer Ritual at its heart
Return to Priestess Elara as Gaela's Champion

notes: Threat/consequence: capstone of the household arc running through gaela_01-09; ties off the Hollis family, Edda and Thornfield's mill by naming them again rather than treating the ritual as generic. Added world_flags_to_set (willow_dale_soil_restored) to the existing accept_champion_title consequence, free per spec since the entry already existed. Giver motive: Elara sends the player at the hardest ground last because the valley's easier fields already proved the method works.
